name: Argentina Falklands 1982
description: Argentina in May 1982: the Fuerza Aerea and Navy strike groups on the Patagonian coast and the garrison on the islands. Stock DCS units plus the community A-4E Skyhawk mod. The Mirage F1CE stands in for the Mirage IIIEA and the Dagger, the MB-339A also for the Pucara, the FPS-117 for the TPS-43 radar, the Gepard for the Oerlikon 35 mm guns, the M113 for the Panhard AML, and the Castle class for the Navy's escorts.
